annotations.title: List recent product recalls (France and EU)

description: Product recalls published since a date in France (RappelConso) and the EU (Safety Gate), newest first, 50 per page; follow next_cursor for more. Narrow by source, category or the notifying country. A French Safety Gate alert merged into its RappelConso fiche is not listed twice.

country.description: Notifying country, ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. FR

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

since.description: Published on or after, YYYY-MM-DD, 2018-01-01 or later
